toolArguments.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story.
Create ONE genuinely transparent independent square 2D head portrait avatar of Yutenji Nyamu for a small companion chat icon. 1024 x 1024, no circular disc, background, scene, text, letter, watermark, UI or frame. This is a new close-up illustration, never a crop of a whole-body room image.

Reference image 1 is an earlier independently drawn 2D Nyamu avatar, used ONLY as an identification reference for her lavender short bob, red-violet eyes and thin black choker/gray ruffle neckline. Do NOT copy its lower-face length, jaw shape, mature surface treatment or particular large open grin. Repaint this portrait from the beginning with the specific new moment below; no pasted reference pixels. No other source image is supplied.

This is an imagined project-original quiet moment, not a claim about canon plot or the user's past. Nyamu has just found the little detail that finally makes a paper idea work. She has already looked at it herself and is now glancing toward the familiar person close by, a split second before she asks if they noticed it. She wants to share her pleased discovery, while still keeping enough composure not to make a performance of it. Let that private small pride brighten her rose-violet eyes. Her pupils attend to the person just beside the lens, brows lightly lift with a knowing unequal rhythm, and the corners of her mouth rise into a clear young lively small smile, a hint of parted lips rather than a wide stage grin. Eye, brow and mouth must make the intent readable at 34–48 px: clever, pleased, approachable, with a little "I think this version is good" confidence, not a blank face, smug sneer, heavy flirtation, pout, wink or exaggerated baby laugh. The head angle may be gently questioning, with the neck relaxed; shoulders are barely included. Do not put paper, hands or objects into this tight portrait.

Keep Nyamu's own recognizable SHORT LAVENDER-PURPLE BOB, jaw/neck length, soft irregular thin bangs and slightly longer fine face-side strands. Red-violet/rose-purple eyes with natural anime iris structure, no color change or second character's hair. She is a youthful intelligent anime girl: naturally short soft chin and lower face, soft full young cheeks, balanced face planes and modest natural nose/mouth. Give the lower face a shorter softer feeling than the reference, not a long narrow taper. Preserve individual identity rather than turning her into a generic round mascot. NO baby proportions, giant glass eyes, infant facial spacing, 3D doll, adult fashion model, mature lip shape, heavy eyeliner or cosmetics. Delicate readable linework, subtle hand-drawn color planes and fresh natural skin, not airbrushed plastic.

Hair and face should fill about 85–90 percent of the whole square so the eye/brow/mouth charm remains clear at real small size; retain the full recognizable bob silhouette with a modest transparent margin for a circular crop. The lower edge shows only a little neck with the THIN BLACK CHOKER and a minimal gray ruffled casual blouse neckline/shoulder straps, matching one complete official-shown casual outfit; no uniform, stage corset or invented jewelry. Not a bust portrait or large shoulders below a small head. Both eyes stay clearly visible, no hair crossing over an iris or fused eyebrow/eyelid.

Art direction: refined independent youthful TWO-DIMENSIONAL anime literary portrait with soft natural daylight and gentle face volume, clean varied outlines, quiet fine hair shapes and a warm small emotional spark. The face remains lighter and simpler than a full scene, with enough contrast to read without a background. Preserve truly transparent alpha around every hair edge; no colored halo, dark/white matte residue, outline sticker stroke, checkerboard pixels or fake background. One coherent freshly painted head and tiny neckline, clear and charming at chat-icon scale.
